description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2510015896198 PANEL,VEHICULAR OPE: Line 0001 Qty 24 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0123 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
